name: Product collection
description: Bring a menu together as a grid or a carousel.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1,
  id: "acme/collection-flex",
  name: "Flexible product collection",
  kind: Kind.productCollection,
  description: "Shows a list of products as a grid or a swipeable carousel.",
  aiHints: "Use when the owner wants to show a category or featured products as a grid or carousel. Options: columns, how many to show, card style.",
  options: [
    ComponentOption(name: "card", label: "Card style", kind: Kind.productCard,
      default: "core/product-card", defaultVariant: "vertical"),
    NumberOption(name: "columns", label: "Columns (mobile)", min: 1, max: 4, default: 2),
    NumberOption(name: "limit", label: "How many to show", min: 1, max: 48, default: 12),
    BoolOption(name: "showTitle", label: "Show title", default: true),
  DataOption(name: "products", type: Product, list: true, required: true)],
  parts: [
    Part(
      name: "header",
      build: If(
        condition: options.showTitle && title != null,
        then: Text(child: title, role: TextRole.heading, level: 2,
                   size: FontSize.xl, weight: FontWeight.bold),
      ),
    ),
  ],
  variants: [
    Variant(
      id: "grid",
      label: "Grid",
      build: Column(
        gap: Space.md,
        children: [
          Use(part: "header"),
          Grid(
            cols: Responsive(base: options.columns, md: options.columns + 1, lg: options.columns + 2),
            gap: Space.md,
            children: [
              ForEach(
                items: take(options.products, options.limit),
                as: "p",
                child: Embed(ref: options.card, product: p),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
    Variant(
      id: "carousel",
      label: "Carousel",
      build: Column(
        gap: Space.md,
        children: [
          Use(part: "header"),
          Carousel(
            itemWidth: 220,
            gap: Space.md,
            snap: true,
            children: [
              ForEach(
                items: take(options.products, options.limit),
                as: "p",
                child: Embed(ref: options.card, product: p),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
